name: Strike Witches: Aozora no Dengekisen - Shin Taichou Funtou Suru!
original_name: ストライクウィッチーズ －蒼空の電撃戦　新隊長 奮闘する!
source:
The Strike Witches take under their wing a candidate commanding officer from the Fuso Empire, Junko Takei. She contacts the 501st to inform them that she will be meeting up with them during a training exercise. At the same time, the military announces a new operation: to make a concerted strike against the Neuroi at the Gallian coastline and establish a new frontline base.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strike_Witches#Video_games]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
强袭魔女们接纳了来自扶桑帝国的指挥官候补竹井醇子。她联系第501统合战斗航空团，告知自己将在训练演习期间与众人会合。与此同时，军方宣布一项新作战：联合打击高卢海岸线的异形军，并建立新的前线基地。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strike_Witches#Video_games]Wikipedia[/url]]
